about:
Acton Custom Enterprises, LLC operates from Holderness, New Hampshire, where it was founded in 2008 by Nick and Bonni Acton. Nick, a native of New Zealand with degrees in mechanical and production engineering, had spent a lifetime modifying and racing cars before a stint with Camp Counselors USA brought him to the Lakes Region. He met Bonni in 1993, and their shared automotive passion evolved from a hobby into a family-owned specialty shop. Bonni, a former corrections officer and school board member, manages the office and operates shop machinery, while their sons Vance and Carl assist with fabrication and sandblasting.

The company manufactures nearly 500 catalog parts across 29 categories and provides custom fabrication services from a facility equipped with a CNC plasma table, Bridgeport mill, lathe, hydraulic press, tube bender, English wheel, and welding equipment for TIG, MIG, stick, and aluminum. Core activities include scratch-building replica cars, restoring original Cobras, completing unfinished projects, and producing historically accurate components such as custom oil pans, cold-air boxes, and programmed dash panels. The shop also offers worldwide pre-purchase inspections, authentication of original Cobras, and on-site restoration travel.

Acton Custom serves the Cobra replica and classic-car restoration market, supplying parts to renowned restoration experts and selling vehicles internationally. Customers range from individual enthusiasts seeking a custom-built replica to collectors requiring verification of originality. The business has shipped products and provided consulting services globally.

The founders emphasize old-world craftsmanship and exacting attention to detail, rooted in Nick’s engineering background and hands-on approach. The company differentiates itself by offering historically accurate details, custom solutions for tall drivers, and the ability to fabricate parts that do not yet exist, all produced in the United States.
